items.claim: A single brain implant decodes speech and gestures at the same time.
Quasar winds carry 100× more power than anyone had measured.
Ice structures can now be 3D printed at room temperature.
Artificial beaver dams lifted juvenile coho survival from 8% to 60%.
Bunsen burners do not sterilize a bench — they can make contamination worse.
items.attribution: Sanders, Journal of Microbiology & Biology Education (2026)

caption: Five results from this week worth knowing about. Which one surprised you most?
alt_text: A seven-slide carousel listing five research results from the week, each with its source, from a brain implant that decodes speech to why Bunsen burners do not sterilize a bench.

es.hook: 5 cosas que te perdiste esta semana
items: Un solo implante cerebral descodifica habla y gestos a la vez.
Los vientos de los cuásares llevan 100 veces más potencia de la medida hasta ahora.
Ya se pueden imprimir estructuras de hielo en 3D a temperatura ambiente.
Presas de castor artificiales subieron la supervivencia del coho juvenil del 8% al 60%.
Los mecheros Bunsen no esterilizan una mesa de laboratorio: pueden empeorar la contaminación.
